high.title: Taiwan Stock Foreign Capital Sold Nearly NT$600 Billion This Month, Capital Flow Shifts to Small-Mid Cap Stocks
high.summary: Foreign investors have sold NT$598.73 billion in Taiwan stocks this March, maintaining bearish sentiment amid geopolitical tensions. While the main TAIEX struggled near the monthly moving average, capital rotated into small-mid cap stocks, driving the OTC index to outperform with a 1.3% gain. Foreign institutional futures net short positions decreased to 36,158 contracts, the lowest since February 26. Market analysts warn that Taiwan stocks face four pressures: monthly moving average resistance, oil price rebounds, TSMC's ex-dividend selling pressure, and TWD depreciation. The divergence between large-cap weakness and small-cap strength reflects risk-off behavior, with investors pivoting toward GTC-related concept stocks and quarter-end window dressing.

high.title: Hon Hai Expects Strong Growth in 2026: AI Server Shipments to Double, Smartphone Business Volume and Price Both Rise
high.summary: Hon Hai Chairman Liu Young-way announced robust 2026 outlook during investor conference, projecting doubled AI server shipments for both GPU and ASIC platforms. The company expects smart consumer products to see both price and volume growth. To meet strong customer demand, Hon Hai will increase capex by over 30% this year to record highs. Liu emphasized AI product shipments will grow quarter-over-quarter with overall volumes doubling, driven by close collaboration with cloud service providers (CSPs) and sovereign AI participation. Hon Hai maintains over 40% market share in both GPU and ASIC platforms and targets 2,000 cabinet weekly capacity in the US. The company's diversified product portfolio focuses on high-end models, with smartphone orders showing both higher unit prices and increased quantities, reducing traditional seasonal volatility.

high.title: Petrochemical Chain Faces Supply Crisis as Upstream Prices Soar, Some Products See 'Daily Price Changes'
high.summary: The US-Iran conflict has triggered supply chain alerts across Taiwan's petrochemical industry, with dramatic price volatility hitting chemical fiber and textile sectors. New Fiber Chairman Wu Dong-sheng reported receiving multiple "force majeure" notices from upstream suppliers for the first time in his career, causing raw material prices to surge over 10% in short periods. Some products now experience "daily price changes" with potential supply shortages expected by April. Far Eastern New Century reported 20%+ price increases in some materials, while Everest Textile noted cautious "price available but low transaction volume" market conditions. The industry faces a critical one to 1.5-month buffer period before potential severe disruptions if the conflict continues.

medium.title: Taiwan Plastics: Seven Advantages Support Operations Amid Global Petrochemical Supply-Demand Restructuring
medium.summary: Taiwan Plastics Chairman Kuo Wen-bi outlined seven factors supporting 2026 operations: China's supply-side reforms starting April, India's anti-subsidy investigation on Chinese PVC, European/US capacity reductions, favorable exchange rates, demand recovery, and Taiwan Plastics USA contributions. China will eliminate 13% export tax rebates on PVC from April and phase out 6 million tons of Eastern coastal PVC capacity, representing 20% of China's total PVC capacity.

medium.title: Formosa Plastics USA Benefits from European Market Opportunities Due to War Impact
medium.summary: Asian petrochemical market tightness has created opportunities for Taiwan Plastics' US operations to expand European exports. PVC, PE, and PP products announced US$220/ton price increases for Q1 2026, helping improve quarterly performance. The war has reduced low-cost Iranian and Venezuelan crude access to China, weakening Chinese petrochemical cost advantages.

medium.title: NVIDIA GTC Conference: AI Revenue Targeting $1 Trillion, Two Major Platforms to Double Next Year's Performance
medium.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang announced at GTC 2026 that Blackwell and Vera Rubin platforms are expected to generate $1 trillion in revenue by 2027, doubling from 2026 projections. Huang emphasized AI industry evolution from model training to "inference" and "agent AI" era, with reasoning-generated tokens becoming the core value creator. This supports strong shipment momentum for key partners including TSMC and Hon Hai.

medium.title: New Fiber's Nangang Corporate Headquarters Breaks Ground: Front-Store Back-Factory Strategy Connecting Taoyuan
medium.summary: New Fiber held groundbreaking ceremony for its Nangang headquarters, expected to obtain occupancy permits by early 2030. Chairman Wu Dong-sheng outlined a "front-store back-factory" dual-core strategy connecting with Taoyuan Yangmei industrial park. The project leverages Nangang's tri-rail transportation advantages and emerging five-center development plan including stations, software, cultural creativity, exhibitions, and biotechnology clusters.

medium.title: Evergreen Marine Headquarters Redevelopment to Add NT$10 Billion in Value, Boosting Net Asset Value Per Share
medium.summary: Evergreen Marine announced urban renewal redevelopment of its Minsheng East Road headquarters. The 1,000-ping site, held for over 40 years without asset revaluation, could potentially increase asset value by over NT$10 billion. Industry experts estimate the redeveloped premium office building could achieve total sales value of NT$12 billion, significantly boosting the company's net asset value per share.

medium.title: Powertech Technology Asset Activation: Completes $1.8 Billion Tonglo Factory Transaction with Micron
medium.summary: Powertech Technology completed its $1.8 billion Tonglo factory transaction with Micron, marking entry into "Powertech 2.0" era focused on AI and memory opportunities. The deal includes HBM and post-wafer fabrication (PWF) foundry cooperation at Powertech's Hsinchu facility. This asset activation strengthens financial position while positioning Powertech as a key partner in Micron's HBM capacity expansion plans targeting AI applications.
